androidToolkit.notifications.mode.markdownDescription: Controls Android Tools notification behavior. `quiet` minimizes pop-ups (status bar + output for info/warn). `normal` still reduces noise (info stays in status bar; warnings/errors are throttled).

androidToolkit.performance.deferBackgrou.markdownDescription: Defer background emulator/device monitoring during activation to improve startup performance.

androidToolkit.sync.autoSync.enabled.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh device/emulator-related views when connected devices state changes.

androidToolkit.sync.autoSync.intervalMs.markdownDescription: Polling interval for auto-sync checks (milliseconds). Lower values refresh faster but use more resources.

androidToolkit.scrcpy.path.markdownDescription: Path to the optional `scrcpy` executable used by `Android: Mirror Device with scrcpy`.

androidToolkit.xml.lintOnSave.markdownDescription: Run lightweight layout XML lint checks when saving `res/layout/*.xml` files.

androidToolkit.ui.mode.markdownDescription: Preset UI mode. `beginner` hides complex tools (Matrix/Gradle Intelligence/Diagnostics), `standard` is balanced, `power` shows all advanced tools.

androidToolkit.projectView.mode.markdownDescription: Project tree layout mode. `android` = Android Studio-like logical groups, `files` = full filesystem tree, `packages` = Java/Kotlin package-oriented tree.

androidToolkit.config.profile.markdownDescription: Active Android Tools config profile. Use `Android: Apply Config Profile` to switch quickly.

androidToolkit.runPanel.actions.markdownDescription: Ordered list of visible primary actions in Run Panel. Use `Android: Configure Run Layout` for quick setup.

androidToolkit.run.autoRetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable auto-retry for known flaky run stages (ADB install, wait-for-device).

androidToolkit.run.autoRetry.maxRetries.markdownDescription: Max retry attempts for flaky run stages when auto-retry is enabled.

androidToolkit.notifications.channels.er.markdownDescription: When enabled, suppresses all info/warn notifications and shows only errors.

androidToolkit.keyboard.shortcuts.markdownDescription: Keyboard-first shortcuts for Android Run Panel actions.

androidToolkit.ui.density.markdownDescription: Panel density for Android Tools webviews.

androidToolkit.ui.fontSize.markdownDescription: Base font size for Android Tools webviews.

androidToolkit.ui.tableRowHeight.markdownDescription: Preferred table row height (px) for Android Tools panels.

androidToolkit.ui.logRowHeight.markdownDescription: Preferred log/list row height (px) for Android Tools panels.

androidToolkit.keyboard.profile.markdownDescription: Keyboard shortcut profile for Run Panel actions.

scripts.test:p0: npm run compile && node --test test/p0-run-scenarios-smoke.test.js test/commands-smoke.test.js
scripts.prepublish:gate: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm test --silent && npm run test:p0 && node scripts/check-release.js
scripts.release:check: npm run prepublish:gate && npm run test:runtime && npm run release:publish:dry-run
